turns.speaker: Lisa
turns.message: I get that practical gifts can show care, but flowers symbolize life and growth. Speaking of growth, what do you think about the idea that it’s a duty towards society to have children? I've noticed people from Kyrgyzstan tend to agree strongly with that belief. What’s your take on it?

turns.speaker: Zihan
turns.message: Well, I can't agree that having children is a duty towards society. I believe that people should have the freedom to choose whether or not to have children based on their own desires and circumstances.
